resources.string: Choose what goes in, then where to save it
Remind me to back up every month
A notification when your last backup is a month old. Robot can\'t back up by itself: it never keeps your passphrase.

A backup is one file, encrypted with a passphrase you choose. Robot never keeps the passphrase: without it nobody can open the file, Robot included. Models aren\'t in it: they download again. Android\'s own backup stays off for Robot.
Can\'t be opened just now: unlock your phone, or leave Memory out
Can\'t be read now: Settings › Files says why
Left out while travel mode is on: it holds answers from Robot Files
Voice, wake phrases, actions, safety, helpers (without keys), web search, Termux, display, updates
Biometric: it needs a strong passphrase, and comes back only from a backup you mark as your own.
Never in a backup: Robot\'s models and voices (they download again), the updater\'s access token, and the apps Robot trusts (you confirm them again).
Put your keys in the backup?

Anyone with this file and its passphrase can use your API keys (and spend your money) and read the passwords and codes you asked Memory to keep. You can also leave them out and paste the keys again on the new phone.
Put your voiceprint in the backup?

Your voiceprint is biometric: it is how Robot knows your voice in a transcript. Anyone with this file and its passphrase has it. It comes back only from a backup you mark as your own, on a phone that has no voiceprint yet. Making it again takes about a minute in Settings › Conversation › Your voice.
Robot made this passphrase for you. Save it somewhere safe, like your password manager.
If you lose the passphrase, nobody can open this backup, Robot included.
Copied. Robot clears the clipboard in a minute.
I saved this passphrase somewhere safe
Type it again, or paste it
Use at least 12 characters, or Robot\'s passphrase.
Fair isn\'t enough with keys or your voiceprint in the backup: make it longer, or use Robot\'s.
It starts or ends with a space: check that it is what you meant.
The estimate can\'t know a song lyric or a pet\'s name: Robot\'s passphrase is the safe choice.
Keep it somewhere other than this phone: a USB drive, your computer, a synced folder.
Robot couldn\'t make the backup. Try again.
Type the backup\'s passphrase, or let your password manager fill it.
Added to what\'s on this phone
Phone lock comes back only with it.
This backup is my own, from my own phone
Leave this off for a file someone gave you. Robot then treats what it restores as something it read, keeps the safer settings, and leaves out keys and the voiceprint.

You\'ll do these again: download the models, make Robot the assistant and allow the microphone, the ADB fixes, the permissions as you turn things on, Messages\' set-up, trusting Termux, the keys and voiceprint you didn\'t include, and the updater\'s token.
Robot restarts once it has restored.
not restored, and nothing of it changed. Try again.
not restored: the phone locked. Unlock and restore again.
finishes after you unlock the phone
not finished yet (short of free space, or a storage error). Robot tries again each time you unlock the phone.
not restored, and nothing of it changed: an earlier restore of it hasn\'t finished (short of free space, or a storage error). Free up space, then restore again.
From a backup not marked as yours: memories show Imported, restored routines and skills are off, and keys were left out.
